sentences.en: The area was revegetated after the mining stopped.
sentences.zh: 矿场停止开采后，那片区域重新长满了植被。

sentences.en: They plan to revegetate the hillside to prevent soil erosion.
sentences.zh: 他们计划重新植上植被以防止土壤侵蚀。

sentences.en: The gardeners will revegetate the old flower beds next spring.
sentences.zh: 园丁们明年春天将重新种植那些旧花坛。
